```{r include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F,message = F)

library(future)
library(furrr)
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5))
```


```{r}
source("./scripts/scripts.R")
files <- list.files("rds_files")[7]
powerDf <- read_rds(sprintf("rds_files/%s",files))
powerDf |> 
  ggplot(aes(or, power, col = model)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(mar ~ prev,scales = "free_x") 
```

```{r}
files <- list.files("rds_files copy")[7]
read_rds(sprintf("rds_files copy/%s",files)) |> 
  getPolygonDf(baseLineModel = str_extract(string = files,pattern = "(?<=model_).+(?=_sample)"),
               sampleSize = as.numeric(str_extract(string = files,pattern = "(?<=sample_).+(?=\\.rds)")) 
               ) |> 
  drawPolygon(filterMaxPowerDiffAtOne = 1)
# ggsave(filename = "recessive_500.pdf")
```

```{r}
source("./scripts/scripts.R")
model <- ModelRecessiveCC()
modelComp <- list(ModelAdditiveCC())
parmsGrid <- expand_grid(mar = .1, prevalance = .1) 

nCases <- 500
model$setParms(n_case = nCases, n_control = nCases)
powerDf <- runFullExperiment(modelRef = model,modelComp = modelComp,parmsGrid = parmsGrid,leaveEmptyCore = 10)
powerDf |> 
  ggplot(aes(or, power, col = model)) +
  geom_line()
```
